transcript: The first 1 lakh comes from having various clients who pay you for a skill that they don't have the time for. So, people who are fighting for their time and you will give them that room that they can then use for other things in their life. You don't have to compete with AI in this. They just want a human who can do tasks for them. So, setting meetings, having email conversations, checking into their flights, communicating with the hotel, arranging things for them. This is stuff that people literally hire people for and continue to do that. You just have like four people like that and they'll easily pay you 20 to 30,000 in a month, and there you go, you have your first 1 lakh. There's no skills in this, there's no growth in this, but there's a lot of human communication in this, which is again very important if you want to learn how to communicate and negotiate and do things like that in the future. Again, a very underrated skill.
